notes.title: LEENIE'S TALE Demo Update – New Mode & Features!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
I'm excited to present the updated demo version of LEENIE'S TALE! 🎉
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088603/ee343e2a9d6edfc8b9eec3c9ad3c17e330694b09.png
I've put a lot of work into expanding the demo, adding new mechanics and content. I hope you'll enjoy it!

What's new?

New game mode – now you must find 5 keys while the fox hunts you! 🦊
In-game achievements – compete with your friends (or with me 😆). I might even share my own results in Discord!
Enhanced atmosphere & improved balance – the game is now more intense, and the difficulties are better tuned.

Challenge yourself!
Think you can handle hard mode? Try it… if you dare! 😈😈😈

Share your feedback!
I’d love to hear your thoughts and impressions, they’ll help make the game even better! ❤️

So download, play, and have fun! 
Enjoy the game! ^^
